# Alok Plastics

> Alok Plastics is a Chandigarh-based manufacturer, established in 1998, of moulded plastic and steel spare parts for water coolers, display counters and deep freezers.

## Facts
- Established: 1998
- Location: Chandigarh, India
- Owner: Gopal Kumar
- CEO: Aalok Kumar
- Tagline: Crafted in Bharat, made for the world.
- Delivery: Pan Bharat delivery network
- Company-reported: 20 Cr+ products successfully delivered
- Company-reported: 70%+ repeat customers

## Products

### Water Cooler spare parts
Float valves, push cocks, waste pipes, couplings, ventilation jalli and adjustable leg inserts for water coolers and dispensers.
- [Connecting Bush](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/connecting-bush/): Brass
- [Float Valve](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/float-valve/): Nylon
- [Push Cock](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/push-cock/): Brass
- [Waste Pipe](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/waste-pipe/): PPCP
- [Waste Coupling](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/waste-coupling/): SS
- [Three Core Plug](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/three-core-plug/)
- [Ventilation Jalli](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/ventilation-jalli/): PPCP
- [Adjustable Leg Insert](https://alokplastics.com/products/water-cooler-spare-parts/adjustable-leg-insert/): HDPE

### Deep freezer & Display counter Parts
Sliding bushes, locks, hinges, springs and gaskets for the doors of display counters and deep freezers.
- [F-Bush](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/f-bush/): Nylon
- [Door Lock](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/door-lock/)
- [Hinge](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/hinge/)
- [Handle Lock](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/handle-lock/): Nylon
- [Bracket Handle](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/bracket-handle/): PPCP
- [SS Kabja 202](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/ss-kabja/): SS
- [L-Type Hinge](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/l-type-hinge/): SS
- [U-Type Door Spring](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/u-type-door-spring/): SS
- [L-Hinge Door Spring](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/l-hinge-door-spring/): SS
- [Gasket](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/gasket/)
- [PUF Chemical](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/puf-chemical/)
- [Bright Chrome](https://alokplastics.com/products/deep-freezer-display-counter-parts/bright-chrome/)

## Guides (blog)

- [Custom Plastic Moulded Parts: Sample to Supply Guide](https://alokplastics.com/blogs/custom-plastic-moulded-parts-sample-to-supply/): Need a plastic part that is not in any catalogue? See how custom moulded parts go from sample or drawing to supply, and what to share with a manufacturer.
- [Deep Freezer Door Gasket & Hinge: When to Replace](https://alokplastics.com/blogs/deep-freezer-door-gasket-hinge-replacement-guide/): Frost at the door or a door that will not close? Learn the signs a deep freezer gasket or hinge needs replacing, what to measure and what to send to order.
- [HDPE vs Nylon vs PPCP vs Brass: Cooler Spare Parts](https://alokplastics.com/blogs/hdpe-nylon-ppcp-brass-cooler-spare-parts/): Which material for which part? A plain-language guide to HDPE, nylon, PPCP, brass and stainless steel in cooler, display counter and freezer spare parts.
- [Display Counter Sliding Door Problems: Parts Guide](https://alokplastics.com/blogs/display-counter-sliding-door-parts-guide/): Sticking or loose display counter doors? A practical guide to the F-bush, door lock, hinges, door springs and gasket, and when to replace each one.
- [Water Cooler Float Valve: Choosing & Fixing Overflow](https://alokplastics.com/blogs/water-cooler-float-valve-overflow-leakage/): Water cooler overflowing or leaking? See how the float valve, push cock and waste pipe work, how to find the faulty part and what to send to order.
